summary: Korean separates nominal predication with 이다 from descriptive predicates and from 있다/없다 existence, possession, and location.

semantic_map.SEM.CHARACTERISTIC_PROPERTY: descriptive/adjectival predicate directly; nominal property uses 이다
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: resultative constructions such as -어/아 있다 or lexical state predicate
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: event-specific predicate such as 열리다/있다 according to event type
semantic_map.SEM.TIME_DATE_PREDICATION: 이다 in nominal time/date identification where required
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: 있다/없다 is a core possession strategy as well as existence
